lines.text: Cut me some slack, I'm new.

data.define: To ask someone to be less strict or critical.

example.text: Cut me some slack, I'm new.

misuse.text: Don't tell your boss 'cut me some slack' daily.

data.l1_hook: Ich bin neu. Bitte sei nachsichtig, "cut me some slack".
data.l1_ex: "Cut me some slack", ich bin neu.

native.tip: “cut me some slack” = Sei nachsichtig mit mir. Beispiel: “Cut me some slack, I'm new.”
